comparisons.comparison: Both JPM and BAC disclose additional unfunded commitments to lend to borrowers experiencing financial difficulty whose loans were modified (FDMs). JPM reports specific allocations to 'Commercial and industrial' ($1.8 billion for both 2024 and 2023) and 'Other loan class' ($69 million in 2024, $4 million in 2023). In contrast, BAC reports a consolidated total for 'commercial borrowers,' showing an increase from $1.2 billion in 2023 to $1.3 billion in 2024, without providing the same granular sector breakdown as JPM.
